# Tier `blackwell-8`

## Serving

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| backend | `cuda` | which `llama-swap.*.yaml` template renders |
| ctx_size | 16384 | the served window (`--ctx-size`) |
| kv_type | `q8_0` | `--cache-type-k/v`, kept symmetric |
| flash_attn | `on` | `--flash-attn` (required for a q8_0 V cache) |
| resident_tier | `offload-e4b` | the model that stays hot; seeds the agent planner seat (agent_model) when it differs from the workhorse |
| agent_ctx_tokens | 16384 | the agent's `-ctx-tokens` compaction budget |
| 26B-A4B | `cpu_moe` | whether the 26B MoE is served, and where its experts live |

## Media

This tier serves these media **seats** — models in its own llama-swap config, rendered
at install time. Each seat also produces the harness config binding that routes to it, so a
binding can never name a seat that was not rendered:

| seat | kind | binds | model | residency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `qwen3.5-9b-vl` | vision | `vision_model` | `Qwen3.5-9B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf` | swappable |
| `paddleocr-vl` | ocr | `ocr_model` | `PaddleOCR-VL-1.6.gguf` | swappable |
| `whisper-stt` | stt | `stt_model` | `ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin` | swappable |

A seat still needs its weights on the box — model downloads stay out-of-band, as with
every seed.

This tier's media bindings are **RAM-gated** (`config_seed_ram_mid_high`): the installer applies
them only when the detected `ram_tier` is `mid` or `high`, so the same tier on a low-RAM box
honestly serves text only.

## Installer-seeded config (non-media)

These `config_seed` keys are applied to a FRESH harness config exactly like the media
seed, but they bind no media route — the agent/cascade seats and per-node knobs live
here so they are never mistaken for a media capability:

| key | value |
|---|---|
| `agent_model` | `qwen3.5-9b-agent` |
| `agent_profile` | `research` |

## Operator notes

Recorded with the profile — several are measurements from real hardware,
including reasons a tempting change was deliberately not made.

> Configs #8/#9 (5060 8GB Blackwell; +64GB adds 26B cpu-moe). E4B resident full-GPU. REQUIRES the Blackwell CUDA-12.8 sm_120 build (Task H4). 26B cpu-moe only when ram_tier mid/high; else dropped. J4: config_seed_ram_mid_high auto-binds the O1 bf16 IMAGE seat on mid/high-RAM boxes (verified on the ampere-8 reference box; image only — no video/music on 8GB by decision 2026-07-23). PROJECTED. J-media 2026-07-28: media_seats = ampere-8's PROVEN CUDA seats verbatim (same 8 GB/E4B/cpu-moe class); tier gpu_env pins the device on both. PROJECTED here (the reference is the ampere-8 laptop, not this exact card). TIER-DOCTRINE PASS 2026-08-16: parity with the twin-arch sibling verified field-identical; the split is build-arch only. Candidate for a single '8gb-cuda' tier id — rename deferred (installer classifier + installed.json compat migration). HYGIENE PASS 2026-08-19 (8GB re-eval, nightshift-9; full proposal in Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-08-19-8gb-tier-reeval-proposal.md): (H1) serving params are UNMEASURED-ON-REFERENCE -- the ampere-8 reference box (Aorus RTX 3070) never ran the installer (ADR 0017 records it UNMEASURED on harness 0.22.22; its capability report shows tier UNKNOWN), so the class's one verified datum is the HiDream ~5.9 min/render; any redesign bake starts with a real install + selftest on the 3070. (H2) the vision seat carries NO ocr alias BY DESIGN pending ocrprobe measurement -- blackwell-16 records Q4 as the measured OCR-fidelity cliff, so the omission is a quality statement, not an oversight; routing uses vision_model, so nothing breaks either way. (H4) agent_profile=research seeded in config_seed (the measured 0-to-72 percent small-seat lever; ampere-6 parity) -- the exact profile value is a bake question, but shipping UNSEEDED is the configuration the house already measured as broken. Low-RAM sdcpp image seed (proposal H5) DEFERRED, not forgotten: config_seed_ram_mid_high MERGES OVER config_seed (tierseed.Resolve), so a base sdcpp block would leak engine keys into the verified HiDream arm unless ~10 counter-keys neutralize it -- that is schema work (a config_seed_ram_low arm), not hygiene. IMAGE SEAT DECISION (operator, 2026-08-20): blackwell-8 runs Z-IMAGE + SDXL for image gen -- Z-Image Turbo PRIMARY via the sdcpp engine (the amd-rdna3-proven binding verbatim: Q8_0 diffusion GGUF + zimage_ae VAE + Qwen3-4B text encoder, steps 8 / cfg 1; vae_mode TILING not cpu -- the seed lint measured cpu as a 7.8x CUDA trap (cpu is the AMD/UMA value); Apache-2.0; FP8-class model on sm_120 hardware), with SDXL PRE-STAGED on the ComfyUI route: imagegen_ckpt RealVisXL_V5.0_fp16 is seeded inert while imagegen_engine=sdcpp, and the comfy route's unknown-family fallthrough IS the SDXL builder with that exact ckpt as its default. THE FLIP TO SDXL IS THREE KEYS, not one -- set imagegen_engine to empty AND clear imagegen_steps/imagegen_cfg (8/1 is Z-Image's turbo recipe; on RealVis it renders mush; the SDXL builder's own defaults are 30/7). This DELIBERATELY BREAKS the ampere-8 field-parity claim on hardware grounds: ampere-8 keeps HiDream-O1, its one VERIFIED datum (5.9 min/render on the reference box). Reference box: OptiPlex 7060 (RTX 5060 8GB, Gen3 x4, rebuilt 2026-08-19); its LIVE config is owned by its own session -- this seed is the durable tier encoding for fresh installs. Weights out-of-band as with every seed. Low-RAM arm still seeds no image path (the config_seed_ram_low schema work). AGENT SEAT DECISION (operator-approved 2026-08-23, MEASURED ON-BOX 2026-08-22): qwen3.5-9b-agent (include_qwen35_9b + agent_model seed). Quality bake on the OptiPlex 7060 reference box (leg 2 of the 8GB re-eval, same fixtures/grader as the ampere-6 bake-off, fresh server per rep, /props-verified, n=2 per shape per arm): Qwen3.5-9B UD-Q4_K_XL with thinking OFF swept - 100% extraction x2 + 5/5 search+reason x2 - while the E4B fallback planner scored 0% x2 on extraction (zero tool calls: it asked which directory instead of listing it), qwen3.5-4b scored 100%/5-5 (the floor arm), and 9B thinking ON was strictly WORSE (89% x2, reasoning prose leaking into content, 3.5x wall). Fit measured on the RTX 5060: 6344 MiB at 16K q8_0, 6696 MiB at 32K (GDN hybrid small-KV) - the entry serves at an explicit ctx 32768. The seat ships llama.cpp's DEFAULT thinking behaviour (off for this template - the measured configuration); never enable thinking on it without a re-bake, and never fold it into the reasoning-off cascade macro (the 4B seat's measured trap). Walls on the reference box are indicative only until its CUDA-12.8 MMQ swap (pinned CUDA-13.3 build falls back to cuBLAS on sm_120). Evidence: Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-08-22-blackwell8-agent-bake/ + nightshift8-notes s25. SECOND deliberate twin-parity break (after the image seat): ampere-8 keeps its E4B-by-fallback agent lane pending its own on-box bake (Aorus offline; seat-lifecycle rule). MEDIA ROSTER MEASURED ON-BOX 2026-08-23 (operator-approved roster; full results: Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-08-23-dell-media-roster-research.md section 0-R; all legs on the OptiPlex reference box at llama.cpp b10603 / ComfyUI 0.33.0 cu128): (1) The 2026-07-23 'IMAGE ONLY on 8GB' video decision is REVERSED BY THE OPERATOR for this tier (editor box role): videogen seeds wan22 I2V A14B Q8 two-stage (measured 520s @832x480x81 with the lightx2v 4-step LoRAs via the per-request fast param, peak 7751MiB; the distilled path stays opt-in per quality-first).
